python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data points (in millions)
march_2001 = 3554
march_2006 = 34736

# Number of years
n = 5

# Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR)
cagr = (march_2006 / march_2001) ** (1/n) - 1
print(f"CAGR = {cagr:.6f} ({cagr*100:.2f}%)")

# Project to March 2011 (5 more years from March 2006)
march_2011 = march_2006 * ((1 + cagr) ** 5)
print(f"Projected March 2011: {march_2011:.2f} million dollars")
EOF
